# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 52 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 52 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_052_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 3 — Winter Trees: You Can't Tell the Living from the Dead

**52:1** He showed me a large number of leafless trees that all looked dead to me — they were all identical in appearance. He said to me: "What do you see in these trees?" "Lord," I said, "I see them — they're all identical, and they all look dried out." He answered: "These trees represent the people living in the present age."

**52:2** "But why do they all look the same — dried out and lifeless?" I asked. "Because," he said, "in this present age you can't distinguish the righteous from the sinners — they look exactly the same. This present age is winter for the righteous who live in it. In wintertime they're invisible among the sinners.

**52:3** It's like this: in winter, trees that have dropped their leaves all look alike — you can't tell which ones are dead and which are still alive. In the same way, in this present age, you can't identify who is righteous and who is a sinner. Everyone looks the same."

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, capturing the eschatological patience required by Similitude 3's winter imagery.*
